jobs.title: Auto Mechanic
jobs.description: At I&I Automotive Modifications , we don't just fix cars—we elevate them. Specializing in high-end luxury maintenance, performance upgrades, and custom modification builds, our shop operates at the highest standards of automotive excellence. We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Auto Mechanic who takes pride in precision work and loves working on high-performance machinery. What You'll Do Perform thorough inspections and computer-aided diagnostics to accurately identify engine, drivetrain, electronic, and mechanical issues on luxury and performance vehicles. Precision-repair or replace worn, damaged, or upgraded parts to ensure optimal performance, structural integrity, and reliability. Execute high-standard routine maintenance, including synthetic oil, filter, fluid changes, and multi-point safety checks in accordance with OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications. Adjust, align, and calibrate mechanical, suspension, and electronic components—including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and sensors—to strict manufacturer tolerances. Follow detailed work orders, project plans, and technical instructions from leadership; collaborate closely with Project Manager to ensure timeline adherence, regular status updates, and smooth project execution. Work cooperatively with fellow technicians, and Project Manager to communicate diagnostic findings, explain complex technical issues, and address additional repair needs.
